title: About me
about: I'm a fullstack developer from Sinj, Croatia, with 4+ years building blockchain products end to end: React and TypeScript frontends, Node.js and GraphQL backends, Solidity and Hyperledger contracts, and the AWS infrastructure underneath.

At Puffer I own frontend engineering across the product suite, from the restaking dApp to the puffer.fi rebrand, and I built the Puffer AI assistant: LLM tool calling over live protocol data, RAG pipelines and layered security.
Off the clock I build for my local football community: a club platform for NK OSK Otok and the Amo na Čanj festival site that ran 130 teams across five sports.

facts.label: Quick facts
facts.education: Master's in Electrical Engineering, University of Split

points: Owned frontend engineering across the product suite: the restaking dApp that handles deposits and withdrawals, the puffer.fi rebrand and the cross-chain interop app, on an architecture, design system and quality standards I set.

Built the backend layer to the chain (BFF API, referral services, Telegram bot, a withdrawal-credential verifier gating validator registration) and Puffer's AI assistant: LLM tool calling, RAG pipelines and prompt-injection defences, red-teamed with promptfoo and garak.
Built the backend and on-chain infrastructure for Smart Ads, an in-game advertising platform: GraphQL APIs, microservices and event-driven AWS serverless pipelines for high-volume ad events.
Wrote the Solidity contracts for on-chain ad verification and wired them end to end into the React and Next.js frontend.
Built the backend for a community platform for crypto listings and token-based voting: REST APIs, the PostgreSQL schema, voting logic and on-chain deposit and reward flows.
Ran the AWS infrastructure and automated the data aggregation with scheduled jobs and materialised views.
Built the frontends for two enterprise blockchain platforms used by hospitals and government: MediioChain for healthcare data exchange and e-Sljedivost, Croatia's food traceability portal.
Delivered React dashboards with real-time d3.js analytics, a React Native app, and chaincode in Go for Hyperledger Fabric.
Before the code: live and recorded match analysis and structured scouting reports for player profiling.
